name: Defiled One
body:
Defiled One CR 14

As it releases a bone-chilling wail of agony, tears of blood cascade down the scarred, pale face of this creature.

XP 38,400
NE Medium undead
Init +12; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Lifesense 60 ft.; Perception +22
Aura stench of death (30 ft., DC 24, 10 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 29, touch 19, flat-footed 20 (+8 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)
hp 199 (19d8+95) + 19 (Toughness)
Fort +9, Ref +12, Will +16
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +2, tears of acid; Immune cold, undead traits; SR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee disfiguring touch +20 touch (14d6 negative energy plus 1d4 Charisma drain)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks disfiguring touch, scream of anguish and rage

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 27, Con —, Int 10, Wis 23, Cha 21
Base Atk +10; CMB +20; CMD 39
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Mobility, Skin Suit, Spring Attack, Toughness
Skills Climb +25, Intimidate +21, Perception +22, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +24, Swim +22
Languages Common, Necril
Sq lifesense, tears of acid

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Disfiguring Touch (Su)

A defiled one can make a melee touch attack that disfigures its target, causing the affected skin to blister, crack, and scar.

Lifesense (Su)

A defiled one notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it had the blindsight ability. It also senses the strength of life force automatically, as per deathwatch.

Scream Of Anguish And Rage (Su)

As a standard action, a defiled one can scream once every 1d4 rounds. All creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 24 Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target takes 12d6 sonic damage and is shaken for 1 round. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not shaken.

Stench Of Death (Ex)

When a defiled one isn’t covered by its Skin Suit, the stench of its rotten flesh is overpowering. All living creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Fortitude saving throw or be sickened for 10 rounds (DC = 10 + 1/2 hit dice + Charisma modifier).

Creatures that successfully save cannot be affected by the same defiled one’s stench of death for 24 hours. A delay poison or neutralize poison spell removes the effect from the sickened creature. Creatures with immunity to poison are unaffected, and creatures resistant to poison receive their normal bonus on their saving throws.

Tears Of Acid (Ex)

Acidic tears constantly stream from a defiled one’s eyes.

Whenever a creature makes a successful melee attack against a defiled one with a natural weapon, an unarmed strike, or a non-reach weapon, there is a 50% chance that the creature takes 2d6 acid damage from contact with the tears.

ECOLOGY

Environment any wetland
Organization solitary
Treasure none

When a particularly vain or vengeful humanoid dies as a result of torture and disfigurement, its restless spirit returns as a defiled one. A defiled one inflicts hideous scars upon its victims, determined to destroy beauty wherever it exists.

During the day, a defiled one wears a thin, fleshy skin that conceals its hideous appearance, making it look like a typical humanoid. At sundown, or whenever a defiled one attacks, its Skin Suit dissolves into a puddle of blood and gore, revealing its scarred and putrid flesh. Defiled ones take great pleasure in the shock and horror that witnessing this transformation evokes in their prey.

While defiled ones can technically be found in any environment, they prefer wetlands (such as swamps and marshes) because they get a perverse pleasure out of seeing their marred image reflected on the water’s surface. This visual reminder of the defiled one’s mortal suffering fuels their hatred and drives their desire to exact vengeance upon the living who are blessed with beauty.
